Experimental feature testing in progress, please pay attention to the comments

Some concerns, see inline comments. The patch adds a user-visible behavior change (fallocate now returns -EOPNOTSUPP on a compressed file) but the added sanity.sh code exercises a sparse/FIEMAP decompression copy, not fallocate, so the new behavior itself looks untested. Consider adding a case that actually calls fallocate on a compressed file and checks for -EOPNOTSUPP.

commit.subject: LU-10026 lov: fallocate is not allowed for compressed files
commit.message:
LU-10026 lov: fallocate is not allowed for compressed files

Client Side Data Compression allocates blocks after a compression.
It is impossible to preallocate blocks for the whole file, so
fallocate should be disabled in case of compression.

Test-Parameters: forjanitoronly
